views.text: In October 2026, Equity Mates described Iluka Resources as a mineral sands and rare earths explorer and said it was benefiting from the robotics trend, pointing to demand tailwinds for its materials.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In July 2022, Equity Mates reported that Export Finance Australia lent $1,000,000,000 to Iluka Resources to build a rare earths separation plant in Western Australia, indicating a major investment to expand into processing as governments sought to diversify supply chains.
